description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an engineering team building systems that help businesses become more discoverable and useful to AI agents. In this role, you will investigate how AI systems crawl, retrieve, and cite information on the web, then turn those findings into production tools and experiments.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and run experiments to understand how AI agents discover, retrieve, and cite web content.

 - Build and ship production systems using the team's web and backend technologies.

 - Build or debug telemetry and routing pipelines that support product development and experimentation.

 - Use findings about AI agent behavior to develop systems that improve web discovery.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 2 years of experience as an individual contributor building and shipping production systems.

 - Production experience with Next.js, TypeScript, or Go.

 - Experience working at a startup or technology company.

 - Background working with large language models at the infrastructure or evaluation level, or building edge systems.

 - Experience building or debugging telemetry and routing pipelines.

 - Curiosity about how AI systems choose what information to retrieve, cite, and trust.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Salary range is $100,000 to $150,000 annually, with equity of 0.10% to 0.30%. Visa sponsorship is not available. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, six days per week.
